platform: Apple Silicon; native macOS WebKit host; macOS 26.5 SDK; macOS 13 deployment target

definitions.PASS: Only the recorded native gameplay condition passed; not whole-game completion.
definitions.LIMITED: Known blocker or incomplete gameplay in a regression fixture.
definitions.OBSERVED: Opening capture only; no gameplay condition passed.
definitions.NOT_TESTED: Indexed but not launched in this investigation.

runs.note: Every indexed title relaunched against the shipped runtime, so the survey and the gameplay cases now share one runtime build.

launch_survey.warning: Staged opening observations use the recorded runtime hashes. They do not certify gameplay or all titles on the final runtime.

cases.scope: Start a level and move the character.

Recover the original launcher, start a match from the title screen, skip the briefing, and swap the controlled player; the 3D match runs with both teams and a ball in play. Scoring and later matches are unverified.

Recover the original launcher, start a match through the team menu, skip the briefing, and snap the ball; the 3D match runs with both teams and the ball moves from its snap position. Completing a drive is unverified.

Recover the original launcher, start the first level from the title screen, and run with the up arrow; the character moves along the roof while the level timer runs. Later levels and scoring are unverified.

latest_runs.note: Native input in two cases landed at the wrong moment while the machine ran out of disk space mid-run; both were re-recorded from a clean run and the original results are retained.
